title: The sync had been dead 22 days, the earlier repair fixed nothing, and the recorded diagnosis was wrong
symptom: weed-sync.service sat in activating for two days; the last successful sync was still 2026-08-03; nothing failed and nothing logged.
root_cause: SSH_AUTH_SOCK pointed at a gnome-keyring agent socket whose daemon no longer serves ssh, so the file exists, nothing accepts, and every ssh blocked in connect() before authentication, where ConnectTimeout does not apply. A Type=oneshot unit defaults to TimeoutStartSec=infinity, so one blocked ssh cancelled the schedule indefinitely.
correction_made: IdentityAgent=none and SSH_AUTH_SOCK unset (the dependency removed, not the symptom); bounded at three levels (per-transfer timeout, TimeoutStartSec=7200, ssh keepalives); and a positive-heartbeat freshness alarm (sync_health.py, GET /api/health/sync, site-wide banner) where a missing heartbeat reads crit and never ok. First run afterwards took the registry from 52 to 78 slugs.
